title: Bounded coherent cohomology of a perfect tensor
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme [pqf-def-locnoeth], E an object of D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], and G a bounded complex of coherent O_X-modules [pqf-def-coherent]. Then E tensor^L G [def-pc-scheme-derived-tensor-structure] has cohomology vanishing outside some finite interval and every cohomology sheaf is coherent. No base morphism, relative flatness or support hypothesis is assumed.

source.place: 0DJQ: verification of bounded coherent cohomology; 01Y0: coherent abelian subcategory

proof.text: Take a finite open cover of X with strictly perfect representatives P for E. Such a finite cover exists by compactness of X and the definition of IsPerfect. Write [c,d] for the bounds of G and [a_j,b_j] for those of each representative on the finite cover.

source.place: 0DJQ: verification of bounded coherent cohomology; 01Y0: coherent abelian subcategory

proof.text: The terms of P are summands of finite free modules, hence flat. Thus the restriction of the derived tensor is represented by the ordinary total tensor complex P tensor G. Its degree n terms are summands of finite sums of coherent terms of G, hence coherent. Kernel and cokernel closure (01Y0) makes its cohomology coherent. Coherence is local, so the global cohomology sheaves are coherent.

source.place: 0DJQ: verification of bounded coherent cohomology; 01Y0: coherent abelian subcategory

proof.text: The j-th total tensor vanishes outside [a_j+c,b_j+d]. Choose one interval containing these finitely many intervals. Vanishing of cohomology is local, giving global bounds. If X is empty, every sheaf is zero and any interval suffices.

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_tensor_bounded_coherent
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (E : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hE : IsPerfect X E)
    (G : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hGb : ∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (G.X n))
    (hGcoherent : ∀ n : ℤ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (G.X n)) :
    (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a ∨ b < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj
            (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G))) ∧
    (∀ i : ℤ, RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) i).obj
            (E ⊗ DerivedCategory.Q.obj G)))
